note: No official source for this year could be read. The Glendale city clerk elections page (https://www.glendaleaz.gov/Government/City-Clerk/Elections) opened but shows only the unofficial results of the July 21, 2026 council election (Barrel, Cholla, Ocotillo districts) and no mayoral contest or election history. The Glendale mayor page (https://www.glendaleaz.gov/Government/City-Council/Mayor-Jerry-P-Weiers) says only that Jerry Weiers became mayor in 2013. The Maricopa County Elections Department results pages (https://elections.maricopa.gov/results-and-data/historic-results.html?year=YYYY) opened and list result files, but every result file returned a Cloudflare challenge page when fetched by curl, and WebFetch returned HTTP 403, so no file could be read. The Glendale document repository (https://docs.glendaleaz.com/WebLink/) returned HTTP 403. The Wayback Machine had no snapshot of the tested Maricopa file. Web search was unavailable (session search limit reached). The election cycle and the vote totals were therefore not confirmed from an official source. Re-check on 2026-10-01: the checker found no format error, and the file format is correct. WebFetch of the Maricopa historic results page for 2020 returned no municipal files. The Glendale clerk elections page again showed only the July 21, 2026 results and no election history. A curl request to the Glendale clerk pages returned HTTP 403, and web search was again unavailable. The unresolved status stays because no official source could be read. Second pass (2026-10-01): WebSearch was refused because the session search budget (200) was used. WebFetch of https://www.glendaleaz.gov/government/city_clerk/elections returned HTTP 404. A request to https://www.glendaleaz.gov/Government/City-Clerk/Elections/Past-Elections returned HTTP 403 Access Denied. WebFetch of web.archive.org was refused by the tool, and curl to web.archive.org returned no response (code 000). WebFetch of https://azsos.gov/elections/results-data returned HTTP 403. The Maricopa historic results page for 2024 opened but listed no Glendale file (only Litchfield Park, Tempe, Goodyear, Fountain Hills). The Municode page for Glendale returned only a title with no charter text. No official source was established, so the year stays unresolved.
